query:
The group treats vinyl as the primary format with digital relegated to a secondary, acceptable role. Does that norm actually apply to everyone, and if not, who has a different preference and what specifically is it?

Options:
A. Theo
B. Ines
C. Olin
D. Dev
context:
[1] (about=Theo, episodic, t10 @2026-02-16T19:22:00) well. fine. I will say it openly. that SACD was excellent. measurements aside, the harmonic structure and dynamic decay were uncannily close to a clean LP, and on a couple of tracks the SACD pulled ahead. I am not converting. but I will concede a well-mastered SACD can sit alongside vinyl. tube preamp and the right DAC and I can listen to it.
[2] (about=Olin, episodic, t16 @2026-03-09T18:04:00) Adding to the admissions; my daughter gave me a Berlin Phil Digital Concert Hall subscription for my birthday. Three weeks of streaming. Hi-res streams from a serious orchestra archive can equal or beat reissued analog. I would not have written this in a column ten years ago.
